description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

BAE Systems is hiring a Software Engineer to support the Air Force’s acquisition of next-generation ICBM systems. The role works with the Rapid Deployment Office to develop secure web and cloud applications in an environment aligned with the DoD DevSecOps reference architecture.
Software Engineer supporting secure web and cloud application development and deployment across cloud platforms aligned with DoD DevSecOps

Responsibilities:
• This role will be working directly with an experienced software development team, the Rapid Deployment Office (RDO), in creating software inside an environment that aligns with the DoD DevSecOps reference architecture
• You will help with rapidly developing web and cloud applications into various cloud platforms with a security mindset

Requirements:
• 0-2 years of professional software development experience (0 years w/Master's Degree)
• Agile software development in one or more; ReactJS, Python, C#
• Familiar with or experience in Cloud native and DevOps environments
• Familiar with Agile software development process
• Proficiency in developing software to transact with complex enterprise relational database platforms such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL
• Experience developing secure microservices and tasks to support REST/JSON based HTML5/JavaScript client-server traffic

Preferred:
• Development of solutions for complex Business Intelligence ecosystems
• Experience with secure IT systems and ATOs which comply with DoD standards and regulations for secure network operations (DoDI 8510.01, RMF, FedRamp, etc)
• CompTIA Sec+ certification or other DoD 8570 Certifications
• Active DoD Secret Security Clearance
